mapper.select: /* com.portal.user.policy.stp.StplatManageMapper.selectStplatDetail */ SELECT USE_STPLAT_ID AS useStplatId, USE_STPLAT_NM AS useStplatNm, USE_STPLAT_CN AS useStplatCn, INFO_PROVD_AGRE_CN AS infoProvdAgreCn, DATE_FORMAT(FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS frstRegisterPnttm, FRST_REGISTER_ID AS frstRegisterId, DATE_FORMAT(LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, '%Y-%m-%d') AS lastUpdusrPnttm, LAST_UPDUSR_ID AS lastUpdusrId FROM LETTNSTPLATINFO WHERE USE_STPLAT_ID = #{useStplatId}
mapper.insert: /* com.portal.user.policy.stp.StplatManageMapper.insertStplatCn */ INSERT INTO LETTNSTPLATINFO ( USE_STPLAT_ID, USE_STPLAT_NM, USE_STPLAT_CN, INFO_PROVD_AGRE_CN, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID ) VALUES ( #{useStplatId}, #{useStplatNm}, #{useStplatCn}, #{infoProvdAgreCn}, SYSDATE(), #{frstRegisterId}, SYSDATE(), #{lastUpdusrId} )
